prompt:
Create a replacement 8-frame pixel-art animation sheet for Bullets of Fury's campaign map. Reference 1 is the previous flame sheet: keep its LEFTWARD wind and 16-bit pixel style but REMOVE its straight white-hot edge and rectangular-panel look. Reference 2 is the actual ocean/island map: the new effect must look like a massive weather/fire phenomenon occupying the map itself, seen from above.
EXACT layout: 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, 8 frames ordered left-to-right, top-to-bottom; no gaps, no text, no labels, no dividers. Square sheet, tall 1:2 aspect ratio frame cells. All frames same fixed camera and size.
In EACH frame the LEFT HALF must be fully OPAQUE dense dark crimson fire and smoke, covering a hidden continent. On the RIGHT HALF this fire mass has a very irregular, ragged organic outline against genuine TRANSPARENCY: broad protruding smoky lobes, deep concave bays, scattered small embers, charcoal-blue smoke wisps. Let empty transparent ocean channels indent between the lobes. A few soft translucent orange embers near the outer edge, not a solid border. Large silhouette variation along the height, like a natural stormbank engulfing a coastline rather than a vertical wall. The edge wanders horizontally by at least 25 percent of each cell width. Do not draw an island or any ocean; the live game's animated ocean must be visible through the actual alpha edge.
Fire flows and flares LEFT, AWAY from that ragged right perimeter, in broad orange/gold tongues. The right roots are broken patches scattered among smoke, NOT a continuous yellow/white line. Keep the brightest flame areas deeper inside to the left; the ocean-facing perimeter is mainly dark red, muted amber and blue-gray smoke. Fine crisp hand-pixelled 16-bit texture, restrained contrast, sharp pixel clusters, no airbrushed 3D fire. Upper and lower cell edges are cropped continuous phenomena, not black borders. No vertical luminous seam anywhere. No rectangle edge on right. Avoid huge white hot highlights. Eight coherent successive fire/smoke poses: stationary overall silhouette, local leftward licking flames and dissipating curls; no translation, scrolling, rotation or zoom. Eighth pose loops to first. Real transparency on right, absolutely no background color/checkerboard baked in. Left half remains opaque at every frame, even black/red smoke. No geography, buildings, ships, words or UI.
